item.text: {"prompt":"Create a square, edge-to-edge abstract painting with no frame or surrounding setting. Make it purely nonrepresentational: use no recognizable objects, figures, faces, bodies, scenes, landscapes, horizons, machines, diagrams, symbols, icons, letters, numbers, or text. Build the composition from a dense, restless center of layered cobalt, bruised violet, and hot vermilion, where rough, dry-brushed strokes collide with translucent washes and fine granular texture. Let sharp, high-contrast marks pulse outward in uneven rhythms, then dissolve into broad fields of smoky teal and muted ochre. Keep one large pocket of near-black negative space off center, edged by thin luminous threads of pale blue and chalk white. Balance compressed clusters of texture against open, quiet expanses; let the brushwork feel searching, interrupted, and alive, with visible overlaps, scraped passages, and abrupt shifts in density. Full-bleed painting, square format."}
